verdict.rationale: Connecting a domain to a host is a fair question for a registrar. The evidence covers DNS management through the API (dynadot-docs-1), MCP-based review of nameservers and DNS records (dynadot-docs-6), and WHMCS DNS adjustments for resellers (dynadot-docs-13). Nothing in the pack shows DNS templates, presets, or one-click connect flows for major hosts or platforms, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
